news.title: Bitcoin stuck as ETF inflows offset selling, but inflation data could spark a move
news.summary: Weeks of sideways trading have crushed volatility, leaving Wednesday’s inflation report as the next potential catalyst, analysts said.

news.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
news.summary: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.

news.title: Brazil's largest lender Itaú is stepping deeper into the tokenization
news.summary: Itaú Unibanco said it teamed up with tokenization specialist OpenAssets to test tokenized bonds and funds in a pilot run by Brazil's financial watchdog ANBIMA.

news.title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
news.summary: The trading platform’s gross crypto revenue fell to $1.35 billion in the second quarter. It also agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

news.title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large
news.summary: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.

news.title: Crypto-friendly bank Erebor in talks to raise $1.5 billion at $9.5 billion valuation: FT
news.summary: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.

news.title: Pokémon cards are becoming multibillion dollar market. Crypto wants to fix how they trade
news.summary: Collectors are spending millions on trading cards, while blockchain startups are turning physical Pokémon cards into digital assets. The harder task is creating enough liquidity to compete with established marketplaces.

news.title: MoneyGram expands on Solana with global crypto-to-cash service
news.summary: Wallets and apps on Solana can now tap MoneyGram's global network to move between digital assets and local currencies.

news.title: CoreWeave’s stock soars as earnings show major AI momentum
news.summary: The AI cloud provider topped revenue and earnings expectations, with its CEO cheering “an important inflection point.”

news.title: Super Micro’s earnings report brings more good news, and the stock is climbing
news.summary: The company impressed Wall Street several weeks ago by teasing an improved profitability trajectory. Super Micro’s latest forecast has exceeded expectations as well.

news.title: Lumentum sees sales more than double as AI demand swells
news.summary: Though Lumentum posted blowout earnings and an upbeat forecast, its stock was largely flat after hours.
